label: sec:su2-so3
html: The compact Lie group \mathrm{SU}(2) and its adjoint quotient \mathrm{SO}(3) \cong \mathrm{SU}(2)/\{\pm I\} govern the internal spin fibre and its spatial orientation frame. This section fixes the Pauli and half-quaternion bases for \mathfrak{su}(2) and \mathfrak{so}(3), computes the first-order Taylor expansion of the q-deformed generators around q = 1, shows how the double cover \mathrm{Sp}(1) \twoheadrightarrow \mathrm{SO}(3) identifies spectral resolvents with \mathfrak{su}(2)-valued connection one-forms, and closes with the generators of the binary dihedral lift \mathrm{Dic}_3 \subset \mathrm{SU}(2) of S_3 \subset \mathrm{SO}(3).
